name: oclif-command-resolution-contracts
instr:
I'd like oclif's command resolution to go through one indexed path instead of each caller deriving it separately. `Manifest` gains a required integer `schemaVersion` (at least 1), while `version` still means the plugin's version. Every manifest entry carries normalized `aliases`, `hiddenAliases`, `permutations` (which always includes the id), `aliasPermutations` and `topicScope` (`"branch"` when another id in the same manifest starts with this id plus a separator, otherwise `"leaf"`), and `Command.Cached` declares all five, with the new ones optional and `undefined` spelled out. Under flexible taxonomy, `permutations` holds every segment ordering of the id and `aliasPermutations` every ordering of each alias and hidden alias, and otherwise they hold just the id and the alias ids respectively. Serializing twice produces the same bytes. Manifests without a schema version are migrated when they're read (aliases and hidden aliases written with spaces become colon ids), so a published plugin resolves exactly like a checkout without a manifest. Permutations that don't permute the id, alias permutations that permute no alias, and aliases equal to the id are dropped, with one `process.emitWarning` per class per manifest, however many values it repaired. `Topic` gains optional `declaredBy` and `synthesizedBy` plugin-name lists, and every topic names a plugin.

Please export `CommandIndexEntry` (`canonicalId`, `command` as a `Command.Loadable`, `id`, `kind` of `"alias"`, `"canonical"`
